targets.name: Cameo on the embroidered bodice
targets.concealment: The small gold frame merges into the bodice's similarly colored embroidery and follows the folds.

targets.name: Blue-jewel filigree brooch
targets.concealment: Dark gold petals sit among other overlapping gold jewelry and repeat the velvet box's floral tooling.

targets.name: Lace fan tucked on the shelf
targets.concealment: The pale lace ribs overlap floral storage boxes and a rose spray hides the lower hinge.

targets.name: Small spyglass on the shelf
targets.concealment: The small dark tubes are partly tucked among lace and roses and share the shelf's brass-and-brown tone.

targets.name: Scissors tucked in the brocade pot
targets.concealment: Thin gold blades disappear into a patterned container whose gilt stems resemble the scissor lines.

targets.name: Little wooden drawer box
targets.concealment: A long ribbon crosses the small case and its brown tooling merges into the surrounding wood.

targets.name: Blue shoe beneath the gowns
targets.concealment: The shoe is partly covered by hanging skirts and its blue-and-gold fabric matches their brocade.

targets.name: Folded lace parasol
targets.concealment: The pale folded lace shares the coat's pattern, while its gold handle merges into the mirror's carved edge.

targets.name: Cream thread spool
targets.concealment: Its pale thread and rim blend into the lace-covered table and overlapping embroidered folds.

targets.name: Engraved hand mirror
targets.concealment: Fine etched gold lines repeat the lace and drawer patterns; the handle lies along a matching embroidery edge.

targets.name: Hairbrush on the dresser
targets.concealment: The tiny bristles resemble the surrounding gold filigree and the handle partly tucks behind the perfume bottle.

targets.name: Cream glove draped on the bench
targets.concealment: Large pale glove has a clear hand-shaped silhouette.

targets.name: Flowered hat with pale feather
targets.concealment: The large feather and clustered roses make an obvious left-side hat.

targets.name: Large blue-and-gold purse
targets.concealment: Large embroidered drawstring bag occupies the foreground right.

targets.name: Cream plumed masquerade mask
targets.concealment: The cream-and-gold mask has a clear eye-hole shape in the glass cabinet.

review.notes: Every target inspected against the finished source and regenerated contour context sheets. Names, full visible defining features, occlusion edges and negative-space holes repaired where needed. Difficulty is an authored estimate; physical iPhone/player calibration remains pending.
